summary.text: Bob Henderson (listed by Ballotpedia as Robert Henderson) is a Republican member of the Iowa House of Representatives, District 2, who took office on January 1, 2023, succeeding Megan Jones, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A retired teacher, he holds a doctorate from the State University of New York at Albany.

paragraphs.text: Robert Henderson was born in Muncy, Pennsylvania.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Kutztown University of Pennsylvania in 1971, a master's degree from Kutztown in 1973, and a doctorate from the State University of New York at Albany in 1984.
His career experience includes working as a part-time teacher, an adjunct professor of mathematics, a university football coach and a musician.

He has been affiliated with the Child Evangelism Fellowship of Siouxland, the Titus Fellowship of Siouxland, the Pennsylvania Sports Hall of Fame, the Fellowship of Christian Athletes and the American Football Coaches Association.
For 2025-2026 Henderson serves on the Education, Local Government, Public Safety and Transportation committees.
